sentences.text:
High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Order Sheet

Crmp No. 1226 of 2023
 Rudra Kumar Versus State Of Chhattisgarh
13.02.2024 Mr. Hemant Gupta, counsel for the petitioner.

entities.text: Rudra Kumar Versus State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. R.C.S. Deo, Panel Lawyer for the State.
Ms. Laxmin Tondey, counsel for respondent No. 2.

When this Court put a specific query to the learned counsel for the petitioner, he would submit that he will not raise plea in view of the decree of divorce granted in HMA No. 63A/2023 vide order dated 09.05.2023 that the proceedings under Section 498A of the IPC be quashed.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would reply upon the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the matter of Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and Another passed on 24th September, 2012 for taking stand that parties have subsequently settled their dispute.

entities.text: Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This factual matrix was disputed by the respondent and she has filed affidavit also to rebut the same.

When a specific query was put to the learned counsel for the petitioner whether for proving the allegation of offence under Section 498A of the IPC dowry which has been provided under the Dowry Prohibition Act has to be considered?
he would pray for time to make submission.
List the case on 6th March, 2024 in fresh matter.

Sd/-
(Narendra Kumar Vyas) JUDGE k Rudra Kumar vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125344028/
